Fable-Opus-Unit: pr10-review-and-release/U01-empirical-qualification Fable-Opus-Timeout-Minutes: 45 ## Goal Empirically qualify PR #10 of oxc-tsrx (branch `codex/octane-integration-compat`, ALREADY checked out in this repo — do not switch branches) and write a findings report. Four questions, each answered with exact commands and observed output: 1. **Do the PR's own validation claims hold?** Run: - `cargo test --release --locked --offline -p tsrx_syntax -p oxc_adapter -p tsrx_parser_engine` - `cargo clippy --release --locked --offline -p tsrx_syntax -p oxc_adapter -p tsrx_parser_engine --all-targets -- -D warnings` - `pnpm test:parser-api` (check package.json for the exact script name; build prerequisites first if the script needs them, e.g. `node scripts/build-parser-native.ts`) - `OXC_TSRX_PARSER_ADDON=packages/toolchain/parser.node pnpm test:parser-addon` If `--offline` fails because the registry cache is cold, retry without `--offline` and note it. 2. **Does this branch fix issue #8 defect 1 (no ASI before a `<` line in an `@{}` body)?** Using the LOCALLY BUILT parser (never the published npm package), parse this fixture and report the `errors` array: ```tsx function Counter() @{ const count = get() } ``` On v0.2.3 this errors with "unterminated regular expression literal starting at byte 78". Also test the variant with a semicolon after `get()` (should be 0 errors both before and after). 3. **Does this branch fix issue #8 defect 2 (Oxfmt structural refusal on trailing `@if`)?** Using the locally built fmt path (find the local binary/entry point — the published bins are `oxc-tsrx-fmt`; check packages/ for how to invoke the local equivalent), run a format --check of: ```tsx function D() @{ const d = get() @if (d) {
a
} } ``` Report whether "formatted TSRX structure differs from the input" still occurs at default options and with `{"semi":false}` config. 4. **Ripple-TS/ripple#1417 equivalence:** upstream Ripple now treats `<` in markup text as literal text when the next character cannot start a tag. Parse these two snippets (inside a valid component body) with the locally built parser and report exact diagnostics or success: - `<3` - `a < b` State plainly: does oxc-tsrx on this branch accept them, and if not, what error. Write the report to `docs/goals/pr10-review-and-release/notes/U01-empirical.md` with: exact commands run, trimmed real output (never paraphrase a passing/failing line), and a PASS/FAIL/NOT-COVERED verdict per question. Create any repro `.tsrx` fixtures in a temp directory outside the repo (e.g. mktemp -d), not in the working tree. ## File contract - `docs/goals/pr10-review-and-release/notes/U01-empirical.md` ## Forbidden moves - Do not modify any tracked file: no source, test, config, or git-state changes; no commit, push, branch switch, stash, or checkout. Why: this is a measurement unit and the PR branch must remain byte-identical to what was pushed. - Builds may write only gitignored artifacts (`target/`, `packages/toolchain/parser.node`, `node_modules`, dist outputs). Do not put repro fixtures inside the repo. Why: keeps the retrospective diff clean. - Do not run the full Octane corpus replay or clone the Octane repo. Why: too heavy for this unit; the four questions above are the scope. ## Verification ```verify test -s docs/goals/pr10-review-and-release/notes/U01-empirical.md ``` ## Blocked permission If evidence is missing, the contract conflicts with reality, or you need a file outside the contract, return status "blocked" with the question in open_questions instead of improvising.

# PR #10 Review, Fixes, and npm Release

## Objective

Review issues #8 and #9 and PR #10 on compiled-run/oxc-tsrx, land minimal TDD fixes on the PR branch for any bugs found, determine whether Ripple-TS/ripple PR #1417 applies to this repo, and then cut a new npm release.

## Original Request

"Please review both https://github.com/compiled-run/oxc-tsrx/issues/8 and https://github.com/compiled-run/oxc-tsrx/issues/9 Especially the PR here: https://github.com/compiled-run/oxc-tsrx/pull/10 From there, I want you to do a new npm release. If you do find any bugs, just go ahead and add the minimal TDD fixes to the PR. Also while you're at it see if we have this too: https://github.com/Ripple-TS/ripple/pull/1417 or if it's needed. Use goal prep skill for the goal, 15m /loop using fable opus cockpit"

## Intake Summary

- Input shape: `specific`
- Audience: oxc-tsrx users (npm consumers of the published packages) and the repo owner
- Authority: `requested` (review, PR fixes, and npm release all explicitly requested)
- Proof type: `review` + `test` + `artifact` (release published on npm)
- Completion proof: new version visible via `npm view` for the published packages, git tag + GitHub release cut per repo release scripts, PR #10 reviewed with an evidence-backed verdict, Ripple #1417 question answered with evidence
- Goal oracle: see Goal Oracle below
- Likely misfire: cutting the release before genuinely reviewing PR #10's diff against issues #8/#9; "fixing" bugs without a failing test first; answering the Ripple #1417 question from the PR title alone without reading its diff and checking our equivalent code paths
- Blind spots considered: PR #10 may need to merge before the release; the release process is script-driven (scripts/, prior release goals exist) and must be followed rather than hand-rolled; npm publish needs credentials that may require owner action
- Existing plan facts: fixes go onto PR #10 itself (not a new PR); fixes must be minimal and TDD; execution runs through the fable-opus cockpit harness on a 15-minute loop

## Goal Oracle

The oracle for this goal is:

`(1) A written, diff-level review verdict for PR #10 against issues #8 and #9 recorded in a task receipt; (2) any bug fix on the PR branch demonstrably preceded by a failing test (test commit/output evidence in the receipt); (3) a source-backed answer on whether Ripple-TS/ripple#1417 is already covered here or needed; (4) a new release published: repo release scripts run green, git tag pushed, and the new version resolvable on the npm registry.`

The PM must keep comparing task receipts to this oracle. A merged PR without a published npm release does not complete the goal; a published release without a real PR review does not either.

## Goal Kind

`specific`

## Current Tranche

Continuous execution until all four oracle clauses hold: review evidence → fixes (if needed) → PR merge decision with owner-visible reasoning → release. The release is the terminal slice and must come last.

## Non-Negotiable Constraints

- Bug fixes are minimal and test-first: a failing test is written and observed to fail before the fix, on the PR #10 branch.
- All Worker-shaped implementation work is dispatched through the fable-opus cockpit packet gate (opus-worker / opus-worker-isolated); no side-channel implementation.
- Use the repo's own release scripts and gates (see scripts/ and prior release goals) — do not hand-roll a publish.
- npm publish and PR merge are outward-facing; if credentials or merge authority are missing, mark the slice blocked with a receipt rather than improvising.
- Verification gates owned by this goal: `pnpm test` (full suite) and `pnpm test:packaging:unit` before release; targeted test files for individual fixes.

## Stop Rule

Stop only when a final audit proves all four oracle clauses, or when the only remaining step needs owner input (e.g. npm credentials, merge approval) and no safe local work remains — then mark blocked with `required_reply` and wait.
